key_points: Microsoft's AI chip roadmap (new AI microchip in 2027, 3 generations of AI chips) bolsters long‑term growth narrative
Azure cloud growth remains robust, with India expansion and strong demand offsetting chip‑maker weakness
Positive price‑target revisions and upbeat Q4 earnings preview support near‑term price upside
Management dismisses AI overcapacity concerns, indicating disciplined spending and potential upside if demand shifts
Risks include macro chip weakness (Micron) and potential layoffs, but market reaction has been muted
